The '''impact crystals''' were a pair of yellow lightsaber crystals owned by a [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]]. They allowed the clone to do more damage with his lightsabers. They were [[compressed energy crystal]]s, because they pulsed slightly.

==Behind the scenes==
These lightsaber crystals appeared exclusively in the Collector's Edition of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''
